title: Moss Landing account separates cleanup progress from operating recovery
summary: The existing Vistra Moss Landing Atlas account gains six sections and six dated events from six freshly inspected primary HTML records. September's fire, battery removal, component-specific closure and potential restart retain distinct scopes.
evidence_note: November 22 inspection preserves operator attribution, a reported nickel screening-level exceedance and two retrieval limits. The quarterly signature date is not represented as EDGAR acceptance metadata. No new project identity, governed Phase 61–64 file, CPUC audit closure, operating series, health outcome or Phase 60 gate is added.
publication_effect: Local source integration only; production rendering, release and launch remain unverified.
